# 各外设配置模板库


## L0轻量系统 — board_config.h 模板

```c
/*
 * ============================================================
 * 板级外设配置文件 (Auto-generated by Lite Config Generator)
 * 芯片: {{ chip_name }}
 * 开发板: {{ board_name }}
 * 系统级别: L0 (LiteOS-M)
 * 生成时间: {{ timestamp }}
 * ============================================================
 */

#ifndef BOARD_CONFIG_H
#define BOARD_CONFIG_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* ========== GPIO引脚宏 ========== */
#define GPIO_PIN(port, pin)     (((port) << 8) | (pin))
#define GPIO_PORT(pin)          (((pin) >> 8) & 0xFF)
#define GPIO_BIT(pin)           ((pin) & 0xFF)

/* ========== UART引脚映射 ========== */
{% for uart in uart_instances %}
/* UART{{ uart.id }} */
#define BOARD_UART{{ uart.id }}_TX_PIN      GPIO_PIN({{ uart.tx_port }}, {{ uart.tx_pin }})
#define BOARD_UART{{ uart.id }}_RX_PIN      GPIO_PIN({{ uart.rx_port }}, {{ uart.rx_pin }})
#define BOARD_UART{{ uart.id }}_BAUDRATE    {{ uart.baud_rate | default(115200) }}
#define BOARD_UART{{ uart.id }}_ENABLE      {{ uart.enable | default(1) }}
{% if uart.cts_port is defined %}
#define BOARD_UART{{ uart.id }}_CTS_PIN     GPIO_PIN({{ uart.cts_port }}, {{ uart.cts_pin }})
#define BOARD_UART{{ uart.id }}_RTS_PIN     GPIO_PIN({{ uart.rts_port }}, {{ uart.rts_pin }})
{% endif %}

{% endfor %}

/* ========== I2C引脚映射 ========== */
{% for i2c in i2c_instances %}
/* I2C{{ i2c.id }} */
#define BOARD_I2C{{ i2c.id }}_SDA_PIN      GPIO_PIN({{ i2c.sda_port }}, {{ i2c.sda_pin }})
#define BOARD_I2C{{ i2c.id }}_SCL_PIN      GPIO_PIN({{ i2c.scl_port }}, {{ i2c.scl_pin }})
#define BOARD_I2C{{ i2c.id }}_SPEED        {{ i2c.speed | default(400000) }}
#define BOARD_I2C{{ i2c.id }}_ENABLE       {{ i2c.enable | default(1) }}

{% endfor %}

/* ========== SPI引脚映射 ========== */
{% for spi in spi_instances %}
/* SPI{{ spi.id }} */
#define BOARD_SPI{{ spi.id }}_SCK_PIN      GPIO_PIN({{ spi.sck_port }}, {{ spi.sck_pin }})
#define BOARD_SPI{{ spi.id }}_MOSI_PIN     GPIO_PIN({{ spi.mosi_port }}, {{ spi.mosi_pin }})
#define BOARD_SPI{{ spi.id }}_MISO_PIN     GPIO_PIN({{ spi.miso_port }}, {{ spi.miso_pin }})
#define BOARD_SPI{{ spi.id }}_CS_PIN       GPIO_PIN({{ spi.cs_port }}, {{ spi.cs_pin }})
#define BOARD_SPI{{ spi.id }}_ENABLE       {{ spi.enable | default(1) }}

{% endfor %}

/* ========== PWM通道映射 ========== */
{% for pwm in pwm_instances %}
/* PWM{{ pwm.id }} */
#define BOARD_PWM{{ pwm.id }}_PIN          GPIO_PIN({{ pwm.port }}, {{ pwm.pin }})
#define BOARD_PWM{{ pwm.id }}_CHANNEL      {{ pwm.channel }}
#define BOARD_PWM{{ pwm.id }}_ENABLE       {{ pwm.enable | default(1) }}

{% endfor %}

/* ========== ADC通道映射 ========== */
{% for adc in adc_channels %}
#define BOARD_ADC_{{ adc.name }}_CHANNEL   {{ adc.channel }}
{% endfor %}

/* ========== LED/按键引脚 ========== */
{% for led in leds %}
#define BOARD_LED{{ loop.index0 + 1 }}_PIN         GPIO_PIN({{ led.port }}, {{ led.pin }})
{% endfor %}
{% for key in keys %}
#define BOARD_KEY{{ loop.index0 + 1 }}_PIN         GPIO_PIN({{ key.port }}, {{ key.pin }})
{% endfor %}

#endif /* BOARD_CONFIG_H */
```

## L0外设使能/参数宏（并入 board_config.h）

外设使能开关、波特率、速率等信息直接以 C 宏形式写入 `board_config.h`，不单列独立文件。

> ⚠️ 不生成 `peripherals.json`。该文件在真实 OH Lite 中不存在。

在 `board_config.h` 的对应外设映射段落后追加使能宏：

```c
/* ========== 外设使能与参数 ========== */
/* UART */
#define BOARD_UART0_ENABLE          1
#define BOARD_UART0_BAUDRATE        115200
#define BOARD_UART1_ENABLE          0       /* 不使能 */

/* I2C */
#define BOARD_I2C0_ENABLE           1
#define BOARD_I2C0_SPEED            400000  /* 400KHz fast mode */

/* SPI */
#define BOARD_SPI0_ENABLE           1
#define BOARD_SPI0_MAX_FREQ         25000000

/* PWM */
#define BOARD_PWM0_ENABLE           1
#define BOARD_PWM1_ENABLE           0

/* ADC */
#define BOARD_ADC_ENABLE            1
#define BOARD_ADC_RESOLUTION        12      /* 12-bit */
```

## L1小型系统 — device_info.hcs 模板（精简版）

```hcs
/*
 * ============================================================
 * 设备信息配置文件 (Auto-generated, L1精简版)
 * 芯片: {{ chip_name }}
 * 系统级别: L1 (LiteOS-A；L1-Linux 路线为 Linux，按 target profile kernel_family 填)
 * 生成时间: {{ timestamp }}
 * ============================================================
 */

root {
    device_info {
        match_attr = "hdf_manager";

        template host {
            hostName = "";
            priority = 100;

            template device {
                template deviceNode {
                    policy = 0;
                    priority = 100;
                    preload = 0;
                    permission = 0664;
                    moduleName = "";
                    serviceName = "";
                    deviceMatchAttr = "";
                }
            }
        }

        {% for host in hosts %}
        {{ host.name }} :: host {
            hostName = "{{ host.name }}";
            priority = {{ host.priority }};

            {% for device in host.devices %}
            {{ device.name }} :: device {
                {% for node in device.nodes %}
                {{ node.name }} :: deviceNode {
                    policy = {{ node.policy }};
                    priority = {{ node.priority }};
                    preload = {{ node.preload }};
                    permission = {{ node.permission }};
                    moduleName = "{{ node.module_name }}";
                    serviceName = "{{ node.service_name }}";
                    deviceMatchAttr = "{{ node.match_attr }}";
                }
                {% endfor %}
            }
            {% endfor %}
        }
        {% endfor %}
    }
}
```

## L1小型系统 — UART配置模板（精简版）

```hcs
/*
 * UART驱动配置 (Auto-generated, L1精简版)
 * 芯片: {{ chip_name }}
 */

root {
    {% for uart in uart_instances %}
    uart_{{ uart.id }}_config {
        match_attr = "hdf_uart_{{ uart.id }}";

        num = {{ uart.id }};
        baudRate = {{ uart.baud_rate | default(115200) }};
        iomemBase = {{ uart.base_address }};
        irqNum = {{ uart.irq_number }};
        wlen = 8;
        parity = 0;
        stopBits = 1;
    }

    {% endfor %}
}
```

## L1小型系统 — GPIO配置模板（精简版）

```hcs
/*
 * GPIO驱动配置 (Auto-generated, L1精简版)
 * 芯片: {{ chip_name }}
 */

root {
    gpio_config {
        match_attr = "hdf_gpio_config";

        groupNum = {{ gpio_group_count }};
        bitNum = {{ gpio_bits_per_group | default(8) }};
        regBase = {{ gpio_regBase }};
        phyBase = {{ gpio_phy_base }};
        regStep = {{ gpio_reg_step | default(0x1000) }};
        irqStart = {{ gpio_irq_start }};
    }
}
```

## 真实示例参考

完整真实芯片配置样本见本 SKILL 的 `examples/` 目录：
- L0: `examples/l0/`（Hi3861 board_config / STM32F407 等）
- L1: `examples/l1/`（Hi3516DV300 全套 HCS）
